The Academy of Music | Premier Music School in Mumbai

Rooted in a 35-year family heritage and now led by its second generation, The Academy of Music is a sanctuary for soulful expression and musical excellence. We offer Trinity College London certified instruction in Piano, Guitar, Vocals, and Keyboard for students aged 8 to 80.

Whether you are looking for a state-of-the-art studio environment or the convenience of home music lessons in Mumbai, our leadership ensures a welcoming philosophy is at the heart of every session. We are proud to be open 7 days a week (9 AM – 9 PM) to accommodate your schedule. Join a community that believes music is a companion for life. Book your trial lesson today!

A Musical Tribute to Usha Uthup & Bappi Lahiri 



Friday, 24th July



7:00 PM – 8:30 PM



Ajivasan Music & Dance Academy, Santacruz (W)



Join us for a vibrant musical celebration honoring two of India`s most iconic musical legends – Usha Uthup and Bappi Lahiri.



Relive the golden era of disco, rhythm, and unforgettable melodies as talented artists of Ajivasan bring to life some of their most loved songs. From foot-tapping classics to timeless chartbusters, this special evening promises a journey through music that continues to inspire generations.



Experience the energy, nostalgia, and magic of an era that transformed Indian popular music, while celebrating the remarkable legacy of these legendary artists.



Be a part of this memorable evening filled with music, memories, and the spirit of celebration.

Some performances are judged by applause.
Some are remembered because they make you smile.

Watching these young voices step onto a stage this big, with so much excitement and confidence, is a moment every teacher cherishes. ❤️🎤

Join our Ajivasan Kids as they bring *The Colours of Bachpan* to life with Bollywood melodies, childhood memories, and pure joy.

featured_reviews.name: Farah Surty
featured_reviews.review_text:
At 65, I finally gathered the courage to pursue a childhood dream I had carried in my heart for decades; to learn how to sing. Joining Ajivasan Music Academy has truly been a life-changing experience for me.

The environment here is warm, encouraging, and deeply inspiring. The teachers are not only skilled but also incredibly patient and supportive, making learning enjoyable at every step. They understand that passion has no age, and that belief reflects in the way they guide and nurture each student.

Another wonderful aspect is that the training is very affordable, making it accessible to everyone regardless of their social stature, without compromising on quality. The support staff is also extremely kind, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile.

This academy has given wings to a dream I had almost forgotten. It has filled my days with joy, confidence, and a renewed sense of purpose. I am truly grateful to be part of this esteemed music academy under the able guidance of Padma Shri Suresh Wadkar ji and his better half Padma Wadkar Ma'am.

featured_reviews.name: harshal bedekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have learned a lot from the academy, and all the teachers teach us very well. The techniques and tricks they share are extremely helpful, especially for our practice. The labs and practice setups available here have helped us make a lot of progress because, apart from the classes, we also get a proper environment to practice regularly. We make full use of it, and it is really helping us improve.

Also, we would love to have more studio sessions, practical lectures, and guest lectures, as they would help us even more in developing our composing skills.

featured_reviews.name: Pradeep Tambe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to sincerely appreciate the wonderful efforts of Hemant Bhosale Sir at Ajivasan Academy for his dedication to teaching tabla. His patience, clarity in explaining techniques, and passion for music truly inspire students to improve and enjoy the learning process. His classes are always engaging, and he ensures that every student progresses with confidence and strong fundamentals.

I would also like to extend my heartfelt gratitude to Kalyani Ma’am for her excellent guidance in singing. Her teaching style is encouraging, structured, and full of positive energy. She pays attention to every detail and helps students refine their skills while building confidence in their voice.

Both teachers create a very supportive and motivating learning environment. Their commitment and love for music make Ajivasan Academy a great place to learn and grow.

featured_reviews.name: Vikas Sharan
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience after having joined Ajivasan Musical Academy at Juhu last October, has been an enriching one👍🎶🎵! My search for a guru ended here in Ansh Upadhyay ji, who has the knowledge and requisite expertise to guide us in our musical journey. His finer nuances, classical approach to singing, introducing various ragas, alankaars, taal etc to us, while correcting the diction and methodology of singing different songs have been a strong guiding force for me. The Academy itself is very well structured with an immensely positive, clean and lively ambience! The staff are courteous and address our requirements adequately well. The monthly Karaoke sessions help us to understand singing on the pre-recorded track, cope up with stage fright in front of an audience and learn to appreciate others' singing. I am enjoying my time at Ajivasan and would encourage others to join based on their liking of Bollywood songs, light or heavy classical in vocals, dance or instrumentation🙂💐🙏.

featured_reviews.name: Asha Bhandarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Can anyone imagine setting off to take up a graduation course in Hindustani Shaastriya Sangeet at the ripe old age of 68 !?! I wouldn't dare to, but somehow got pushed into it; destiny drew me to the steps of Ajivasan Academy, where I got sent straight to Ms Nehal's classroom; I smiled humbly, but not for too long! Soon I discovered Nehal ma'am to be a hard task master, a disciplinarian, a stickler for perfection. Yet I persevered & continued my journey with zeal; & I soon found my foothold in the Academy. With time, I had to inevitably accept my ma'am to be a tough protector, having a tough exterior with genuine empathy underneath.
My goal is years away, but today, at 72, I know I'm here to stay; I'm here, despite my recurrent absenteeism due to age related health challenges... yet striving happily through my 5th year to make my dreams come true.
Only you could make this happen @Ajivasan Academy, under the mentorship of Ms Nehal, your trusted teacher, who could hone my faculties thus. 🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Greeshma Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been learning Hindustani classical at Ajivasan, Juhu for last one year. My experience here has been very enriching. The teaching style is properly structured. The mentors here are supportive, patient and encouraging. Each student gets opportunities to perform in front of live audience. My musical journey at Ajivasan so far has been deeply fulfilling and exciting.

featured_reviews.name: Amrapali Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text: Shaayr has been learning Hindustani classical music at Ajivasan for over a year now and is currently at the Praveshika level. It has been a very positive experience for us. Nibedita ma’am is an excellent teacher - very patient and attentive while teaching both songs and sargams to the children. The batch is also well-structured and age-appropriate, which really helps in keeping the kids engaged. Overall, we’re very happy with the learning environment and progress.

Its always welcoming here and professional. Thank you Ajivasan to be such a great push for my musical journey.😇🧡🧡

featured_reviews.name: Mohit Kundu
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was referred to Palak for my son’s keyboard lessons and found her pleasant to speak with initially. She suggested taking trial sessions with two tutors, but charged full amount for both, which I found unusual since most others either don’t charge or offer discounted trials. Despite my son choosing one tutor, she kept promoting the other tutor who wasn’t even available for a couple of months.

Anyway, after selecting the tutor my son preferred, she insisted that I pay for a month in advance. However, after just a couple of classes, Palak informed me that the tutor had left and offered to send a replacement. I didn’t feel comfortable continuing and requested a refund for the unused classes, but she declined citing her policy.

While I understand that such situations can happen, I wish the handling had been more flexible and considerate. To add to the concern, the tutor recently approached me to inform that he hadn’t been paid either. Overall, the experience was disappointing and I’d advise others to be cautious when dealing with her.
